$comment: Central per-repo opt-out list for the GHAS-gated workflows. The org-bootstrap-repo action's `variables` phase reads this and sets/clears the CLDMV_SKIP_CODE_SCANNING / CLDMV_SKIP_DEPENDENCY_REVIEW repo Actions variables to match, so the decision is recorded here (and survives re-bootstraps) instead of living as undocumented hand-set variables. A repo NOT listed gets both variables CLEARED on bootstrap (warn-on-clear) — add an entry before bootstrapping any repo that needs a skip. Whether a private repo skips or pays for GitHub Advanced Security is a purchasing decision; visibility alone never implies a skip. Keys are `owner/name` (case-insensitive). Per-repo flags: skip_code_scanning (codeql.yml uploads an empty 0-alert SARIF instead of analyzing), skip_dependency_review (dependency-review.yml completes green without running). `reason` is required documentation for humans. Tracked in CLDMV/.github#213.

CLDMV/jsonv-vscode.reason: Declarative VS Code grammar extension (TextMate JSON, no JS/TS) — CodeQL fails 'no source code seen'; empty-SARIF result keeps the code_scanning ruleset gate satisfiable.
